options.text: The mango tree is a producer; the goat is a consumer.
The goat is a producer; the mango tree is a consumer.
Both are producers because both are living organisms.
The mango tree is a producer only when its fruits look ripe and yellow.

stem:
Yash watches a mango tree that makes its own food by photosynthesis and a goat that eats only plant leaves and shoots.

Which claim correctly classifies them by how they obtain food?

teacher.key_rationale: Photosynthesis makes the mango tree a producer; the goat cannot make its own food and eats plants, so it is a consumer.
